svg.font-family: 'Red Hat Text', Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The per-pass test on Inkling 2 Mini: physical layers, cache slots and the five conditions
svg.desc: Layers 0 to 5 run once, layers 6 to 17 run on three passes, layers 18 to 23 run once. Pass 1 uses slots 6 to 17, pass 2 slots 24 to 35, pass 3 slots 36 to 47. Block B2, layers 6 to 11, is set to 2 bits on pass 1 only, pass 2 only, pass 3 only, or all three passes.
svg.text: Inkling 2 Mini at P = 3. One block of expert weights goes to 2 bits on one pass, or on all three.
Passes 2 and 3 start again from the output of layer 5 and read the previous pass through the loop-control tensors.
one for each visit of a core layer

svg.text: A slot shares the weights of its physical layer and keeps its own KV state. With our patch a slot can carry
its own expert tensors, so one pass can run on different expert weights. Strong fill marks B2.
how the file is built (base: our IQ4_NL build)
blk.6-11 from the 2-bit pool, no slot tensors
2-bit level: IQ2_XXS gate_up, stock Q2_0 down
dk is the change in log-probabilities against the base when pass k is at 2 bits. We compare dall with d1 + d2 + d3.
Control: the same block split by layer pair (6-7, 8-9, 10-11) on all passes. Those three parts share no weights.
